items.item_text: Vendor Management - Create and maintain campus software catalog; manage Value-Added Resellers (VAR) and associated catalog build; manage and store accessibility and security documentation for approved campus software; create and maintain reports of requested software; manage relationships with major campus vendors through regular meetings; create and maintain UC Merced software need analysis & roadmap; create and maintain stakeholder documentation for software not centrally managed.

License & Contract Management - Manage key software vendor contracts; build and maintain software license provisioning database; manage annual renewals and co-terms; maintain and manage OIT software renewals data; create and maintain regular reporting for campus and OIT leadership on current spend and tail spend to inform strategic planning; manage new provisioning and renewals for internal OIT software (i.e. ServiceNow, Jira, Airtable); manage new provisioning for campus enterprise software (i.e. Adobe CC, Zoom Webinar, Microsoft dd-Ons, etc.).

Software Process, Strategy, and Relationship Building - Rebuild and champion campus software procurement process to enable efficiency and policy compliance; partner with campus procurement to understand and contain distributed software spend across campus; collaborate with key campus stakeholders such as Procurement, Information Security, Accessibility, and Risk Management; collaborate with key external stakeholders such as UC Office of the President and other UC system contacts.
